column1: # local-artifacts.tsv — the register of gitignored paths that tracked documentation
# Being gitignored is not an excuse for a document to promise something a clone
# cannot obtain. Every path here is absent from a fresh clone by design, and every
# row must say WHY it is excluded, WHETHER a third party can obtain it at all, and
# BY WHAT ROUTE. A documented gitignored path with no row fails the build.
#   2 class                  licensed | database | generated | secret | log
#   3 reader-obtainable      yes | no  — can a stranger end up with this exact
#                            artifact, byte-for-byte or by a route we can name?
#   4 substitute route       what a third party actually does instead. Never "N/A".
